title: release-create
description: Adds a signed agent release to the update store (docs/spec/07-upgrade-channel.md step 3): the manifest exactly as the pipeline signed it, and its detached signature. The server checks the signature against the release keys it knows of; the package zip follows in a second request and must match the manifest's hash and size. None of this is the protection: each agent checks everything again against its own compiled-in key.

manifest.description: Base64 of the manifest's exact bytes.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.
